card.name: Linking words before 'treatment' or 'use'
card.fires_on: Small linking words like 'during' or 'of' right after a time phrase (at any time, at the beginning) where the next word is likely 'treatment' or 'use'. Seen in warning text about when side effects occur.

modes.label: during after 'at any time'
modes.description: The word 'during' follows 'at any time' in a warning about when serious events can occur.
modes.example: These events can occur at any time<< during>> use and without warning symptoms.

modes.label: of after 'beginning'
modes.description: The word 'of' follows 'at the beginning' and leads into 'treatment'.
modes.example: Generally, these risks are greatest at the beginning<< of>> treatment and during dose escalation.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict 'treatment' (and its translations) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word before 'treatment' in phrases like 'at any time during' or 'at the beginning of'.
